async processFrame(frame: VideoFrame | ImageData): Promise<void> {\n446\t    const frameIndex = this.frameCount++;\n447\t    const timestamp = performance.now();\n448\t\n449\t    // AP2's ratchet handleDecodeResult(frameIndex: number, result: DecodedFrameResult, error?: string): void {\n494\t    const frameTimestamp = this.frameTimestamps.get(frameIndex);\n495\t    if (frameTimestamp === undefined || frameTimestamp === null) {\n496\t      console.error('[Camera Pipeline] No timestamp for frame index:', frameIndex);\n497\t      return;\n498\t    }\n499\t    // Clean up the timestamp entry to prevent Map growth (bf-2p07 fix)\n500\t    this.frameTimestamps.delete(frameIndex);\n501\t\n502\t    const decodeMs = performance.now() - frameTimestamp;\n503\t    this.decodedCount++;\n504\t\n505\t    // Circular buffer: Store latency in bounded array (bf-2p07 fix)\n506\t    // This prevents unbounded growth that caused 4.7x degradation over long sessions\n507\t    if (this.decodeLatencies.length < this.MAX_DECODE_LATENCIES) {\n508\t      // Fill phase: append until buffer is full\n509\t      this.decodeLatencies.push(decodeMs);\n510\t    } (this.decodeLatenciesIndex + 1) % this.MAX_DECODE_LATENCIES;\n514\t    }\n515\t\n516\t    this.packetsPerFrame.push(result.packets.length);\n517\t\n518\t    // Update ROI based on decoded positions (AP2's ratchet guard)\n519\t    this.updateROI(result);\n520\t\n521\t    // Feed frame to stall detector for diagnostic analysis (F2)\n522\t    const stats = {\n523\t      captureFps: this.currentCaptureFps,\n524\t      decodeFps: this.currentDecodeFps,\n525\t      packetsPerSec: this.currentPacketsPerSec,\n526\t    };\n527\t    this.stallDetector.updateFrame(result, stats);\n528\t\n529\t    // Invoke callback if set\n530\t    if (this.onFrameResult) {\n531\t      const frameResult: FrameResult = {\n532\t        frameIndex,\n533\t        result,\n534\t        decodeMs,\n535\t        ...(error !== undefined ? { error } : {}),\n536\t      };\n537\t      this.onFrameResult(frameResult);\n538\t    }\n539\t  }\n540\t\n541\t  /**\n542\t   * Handle a pipeline  }\n549\t  }\n550\t\n551\t  /**\n552\t   * Update performance metrics (called periodically).\n553\t   */\n554\t  private updateMetrics(): void {\n555\t    const now = performance.now();\n556\t    const elapsed = now - this.lastFpsUpdate;\n557\t\n558\t    if (elapsed < 1000) {\n559\t      return; // Update every second\n560\t    }\n561\t\n562\t    // Calculate capture FPS\n563\t    this.currentCaptureFps = (this.frameCount - this.droppedCount) / (elapsed / 1000);\n564\t\n565\t    // Calculate decode FPS\n566\t    this.currentDecodeFps = this.decodedCount / (elapsed / this.packetsPerFrame = [];\n578\t  }\n579\t\n580\t  /**\n581\t   * Get current pipeline statistics.\n582\t   */\n583\t  getStats(): PipelineStats {\n584\t    // Calculate latency percentiles\n585\t    const sortedLatencies = [...this.decodeLatencies].sort((a, b) => a - b);\n586\t    const p50Index = Math.floor(sortedLatencies.length * 0.5);\n587\t    const p99Index = Math.floor(sortedLatencies.length * 0.99);\n588\t    const avgLatency = sortedLatencies.length > 0\n589\t      ? sortedLatencies.reduce((sum, lat) => sum + lat, 0) / sortedLatencies.length\n590\t      : 0;\n591\t\n592\t    return {\n593\t      captureFps: this.currentCaptureFps,\n594\t      decodeFps: this.currentDecodeFps,\n595\t      packetsPerSec: this.currentPacketsPerSec,\n596\t }\n605\t\n606\t  /**\n607\t   * Set the frame result callback.\n608\t   */\n609\t  setFrameResultCallback(callback: FrameResultCallback): void {\n610\t    this.onFrameResult = callback;\n611\t  }\n612\t\n613\t  /**\n614\t   * Set the error callback.\n615\t   */\n616\t  setErrorCallback(callback: ErrorCallback): void {\n617\t    this.onError = callback;\n618\t  }\n619\t\n620\t  /**\n621\t   * A tight ROI crop to the screen quad is what makes 4K\n668\t   * affordable - decoding only the screen region keeps px/module high while\n669\t   * bounding pixel count.\n670\t   *\n671\t   * Logic from spike/rig.js lines 237-263:\n672\t   * - Extract bounding box of all detected QR codes\n673\t   * - Add 8% margin for drift (tight vs previous 35%)\n674\t   * - Reset ROI after 16 consecutive misses (more tolerant with tight margin)\n675\t   * - Periodic full-frame rescan every 120 frames (less frequent than before)\n676\t   */\n677\t  private updateROI(result: DecodedFrameResult): void {\n678\t    const decodedTiles = result.diagnostics.filter(d => d.decoded && d.position);\n679\t\n680\t    if (decodedTiles.length > 0) {\n681\t      // Extract bounding box from all detected positions\n682\t      let xMin = Infinity, yMin = Infinity, xMax = -Infinity, yMax = -Infinity;\n683\t\n684\t      for (const tile of decodedTiles) {\n685\t        if (!tile.position) continue;\n686\t        for (const pt of tile.position) {\n687\t          xMin = Math.min(xMin, pt.x);\n688\t          yMin = Math.min(yMin, pt.y);\n689\t          xMax = Math.max(xMax, pt.x);\n690\t          yMax = Math.max(yMax, pt.y);\n691\t        }\n692\t      }\n693\t\n694\t      if (isFinite(xMin) && isFinite(yMin) && isFinite(xMax) && isFinite(yMax)) {\n695\t        // Apply ROI offset if currently cropped\n696\t        const offsetX = this.currentROI?.x || 0;\n697\t        const offsetY = this.currentROI?.y || 0;\n698\t\n699\t        // Calculate dimensions with margin\n700\t        const width = xMax - xMin;\n701\t        const height = yMax - yMin;\n702\t        const margin = this.ROI_MARGIN * Math.max(width, height);\n703\t\n704\t        // Constrain to frame bounds\n705\t        // Get actual capture dimensions from the video track settings\n706\t        const trackSettings = this.videoTrack?.getSettings();\n707\t        const maxWidth = trackSettings?.width ? trackSettings.width : 1920;\n708\t        const maxHeight = trackSettings?.height ? trackSettings.height : 1080;\n709\t\n710\t        this.currentROI = {\n711\t          x: Math.max(0, Math.round(offsetX + xMin - margin)),\n712\t          y: Math.max(0, Math.round(offsetY + yMin - margin)),\n713\t          w: Math.min(maxWidth, Math.round(width + 2 * margin)),\n714\t          h: Math.min(maxHeight, Math.round(height + 2 * margin)),\n715\t        };\n716\t\n717\t        this.roiMisses = 0; // Reset miss counter\n718\t        console.debug('[Camera Pipeline] ROI updated:', this.currentROI);\n719\t      }\n720\t    } else if (this.currentROI) {\n721\t      // No QR codes detected - increment miss counter\n722\t      this.roiMisses++;\n723\t      if (this.roiMisses > this.ROI_MAX_MISSES) {\n724\t        // Lost lock - go wide again\n725\t        this.currentROI = null;\n726\t        this.roiMisses = 0;\n727\t        console.debug('[Camera Pipeline] ROI lost lock - going wide');\n728\t      }\n729\t    }\n730\t  }\n731\t\n732\t  /**\n733\t   * Crop a frame to the specified ROI.\n734\t   */\n735\t  private cropFrame(frame: VideoFrame | ImageData, roi: ROI): VideoFrame | ImageData {\n736\t    // For VideoFrame, we need to draw to a canvas and extract the ROI\n737\t    if ('format' in frame && 'close' in frame) {\n738\t      // It's a VideoFrame - convert to ImageData with crop\n739\t      return this.cropVideoFrame(frame as VideoFrame, roi);\n740\t    } else {\n741\t      // It's already ImageData - crop directly\n742\t      return this.cropImageData(frame as ImageData, roi);\n743\t    }\n744\t  }\n745\t\n746\t  /**\n747\t   * Crop a VideoFrame to the specified ROI.\n748\t   */\n749\t  private cropVideoFrame(frame: VideoFrame, roi: ROI): ImageData {\n750\t    const width = (frame as unknown as { codedWidth?: number; displayWidth?: number }).codedWidth ?? (frame as unknown as { codedWidth?: number; displayWidth?: number }).displayWidth ?? 1920;\n751\t    const height = (frame as unknown as { codedHeight?: number; displayHeight?: number }).codedHeight ?? (frame as unknown as { codedHeight?: number; displayHeight?: number }).displayHeight ?? 1080;\n752\t    const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(width, height);\n753\t    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');\n754\t    if (!ctx) {\n755\t      throw new Error('Failed to get 2D context for ROI crop');\n756\t    }\n757\t\n758\t    // Draw the full frame\n759\t    ctx.drawImage(frame, 0, 0);\n760\t\n761\t    // Extract the ROI region\n762\t    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(roi.x, roi.y, roi.w, roi.h);\n763\t\n764\t    // Close the original frame\n765\t    frame.close();\n766\t\n767\t    return imageData;\n768\t  }\n769\t\n770\t  /**\n771\t   * Crop ImageData to the specified ROI.\n772\t   */\n773\t  private cropImageData(imageData: ImageData, roi: ROI): ImageData {\n774\t    const { width, height, data } = imageData;\n775\t\n776\t    // Validate ROI bounds\n777\t    if (roi.x < 0 || roi.y < 0 || roi.x + roi.w > width || roi.y + roi.h > height) {\n778\t      console.warn('[Camera Pipeline] ROI out of bounds, using full frame:', roi);\n779\t      return imageData;\n780\t    }\n781\t\n782\t    // Create new ImageData for the cropped region\n783\t    const cropped = new ImageData(roi.w, roi.h);\n784\t    const srcData = data;\n785\t    const dstData = cropped.data;\n786\t\n787\t    for (let y = 0; y < roi.h; y++) {\n788\t      const srcY = roi.y + y;\n789\t      const srcOffset = srcY * width * 4 + roi.x * 4;\n790\t      const dstOffset = y * roi.w * 4;\n791\t\n792\t      // Copy one row of pixels\n793\t      dstData.set(srcData.subarray(srcOffset, srcOffset + roi.w * 4), dstOffset);\n794\t    }\n795\t\n796\t    return cropped;\n797\t  }\n798\t\n799\t  /**\n800\t   * Stop the camera pipeline.\n801\t
